minutes.headline: Select Board ratified a new full-time patrolman and a facilities director, both unanimously, and previewed a liquor license hearing.
minutes.summary: The board ratified two town manager appointments: a full-time patrolman and a facilities director. Members then reviewed liquor license hearing materials ahead of the evening's hearing and agreed it could be issued contingent on inspections. They also discussed their charter authority to investigate the fiscal 2023 tax assessment process and the format of the next meeting, then adjourned to move to the high school auditorium.
